prompt: How many versions of the .NET platform have been released that have a support lifetime of more than 12 months?
answer:
Counting the released **.NET Core/.NET versions from 1.0 through .NET 10**, **12 versions** have had a support lifetime of more than 12 months.

The only exception was **.NET Core 3.0**, supported for roughly five months. **.NET Core 2.2** qualifies because it ran from December 4, 2018, to December 23, 2019—just over 12 months.
